summary: Phase E.1 Polish Sprint testing — backend 9/9 NEW PASS + full regression 95/95 PASS (incl. iter5 task.completed_at FIXED). Frontend smoke confirms editor is now fully Italian (previously EN fallback): Ispettore blocco / Livelli / Presenta / Invia in revisione / Condividi / Immagine / Testo / Palette / Nota / Prodotto / Materiale all IT. tabs `tab-inspector` & `tab-layers` ✓, `present-btn` ✓ (text='Presenta'), Livelli click → `layers-panel` ✓ (renders 'LIVELLI 0' since opened board empty), Presenta click → `presentation-mode` ✓ (header 'PRESENTA Marco — Living', exit btn 'Esci dalla presentazione', footer counter '1/0'), Esc closes presentation ✓. All 23 IT i18n keys for new strings (Livelli/Presenta/Blocca/Sblocca/Nascondi/Mostra/Porta avanti/Porta indietro/Duplica/Carica immagine/Trascina un'immagine.../Ritaglio e focal point/Modalità adattamento/Punto focale/Zoom/Opacità/Rotazione/Riempi/Adatta/Distorci/etc.) verified present in GET /api/blueprint/i18n/it. Backend: duplicate endpoint clones with offset (+24,+24), z_index+1, locked=False, content preserved, no JSONB leaks; PUT locked/hidden/opacity/rotation all persist to structured columns (verified via psycopg2 SELECT on moodboard_elements); PATCH batch with `style` payload persists crop_x/focal_point/fit_mode/zoom to style_json JSONB; V2 scaffold tables (moodboard_templates 21 cols, template_blocks 13 cols, moodboard_versions 14 cols, moodboard_comments 19 cols) all exist with proper FK constraints (template_blocks→templates, versions+comments→moodboards+tenants), NOT exposed via REST (returns 404 on /api/moodboard-templates etc.) as intended; POST /api/storage/signed-upload returns valid signed_url for moodboard-assets bucket.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 (not 404) because the path collides with the parametrized route /api/moodboards/{id} with id='templates' and the handler attempts a UUID coercion or DB lookup that crashes. Cosmetic — V2 endpoint correctly not exposed via dedicated routes, but the route ordering yields a 500 instead of clean 404 for non-UUID moodboard ids. Fix: validate {id} as UUID at the route level (Path regex or Pydantic UUID type) so non-UUID hits return 422/404.

action_items: Optional: UUID-validate /api/moodboards/{id} path param to return 404/422 instead of 500 on non-UUID ids (e.g. /api/moodboards/templates → 500 today).
critical_code_review_comments: duplicate_block in routers/moodboards_v1.py correctly resets locked=False on the clone while preserving hidden/opacity/rotation — good. Consider also resetting hidden=False so a duplicate is always visible by default (currently hidden state is copied).
Batch `style` merge in routers/moodboards_v1.py line 309-310 properly does shallow-merge old style + new — verified crop_x/focal_point/fit_mode/zoom persist correctly through PATCH /blocks/batch.

V2 scaffold tables in migration 006 are queryable, have correct FK cascade rules (templates→tenants ON DELETE CASCADE, template_blocks→templates ON DELETE CASCADE, versions→moodboards ON DELETE CASCADE, comments→moodboard_elements ON DELETE SET NULL). All 12 indexes present.
Frontend i18n IT bundle now COMPLETE for editor screen — iter5 regression FIXED. All 23 new keys (layers/presentation/upload/crop) translated correctly.
